random_generator: Python random.Random MT19937; input sequences materialized and hashed

secondary_mutation_scores.reason: Prespecified omission; use representation and CID-construct controls; no score fishing

zero_vector_policy: Fail readout if activation norm <= epsilon; no inflated denominator epsilon
numerical_floor_rule: E1 establishes eta per model/layer as max(1e-7,10 times maximal per-residue normalized-vector L2 discrepancy among three repeats of each artificial input). Undefined T when WT RMS context denominator <= 4*eta; effect below 8*eta cannot support specificity. Freeze backend and eta in E1 before any biological input.
